# vendor/

Third-party JavaScript, served locally rather than from a CDN so the desk
works offline and its dependencies are pinned in the repository.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js` | TradingView Lightweight Charts 4.1.3 |
| `lightweight-charts-LICENSE.txt` | its licence — keep it beside the file |

**Do not edit these files.** Replace them wholesale on a version bump and note
the version in `docs/`.
